# CBI Julphar Towers

> These offices occupy the 30th and 31st floors of Julphar Towers, a twin-tower landmark in Dafan Al Nakheel, Ras Al Khaimah. They serve CBI, a commercial bank operating across the United Arab Emirates. The 43-storey towers stand beside the Al Manama-Ras Al Khaimah road and combine 468 offices with 349 apartments above a shared podium, with sea and lagoon views from the upper levels.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Nakheel,, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project covered the 30th and 31st floors of Julphar Tower in Ras Al Khaimah, fitted out as office space for CBI (Commercial Bank International), with Bluehaus as consultant. Julphar Towers is a mixed-use residential and office complex in Al Nakheel. MENASCO delivered the MEP works for both floors, providing the building services for the bank's workplace within the tower.
